### I Can't Find the Words
Author: Suzie Eller
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-november-26-2012.html
Passage: Acts 7:22
Points:
- Moses fled to obscurity and resisted God's call because he felt inadequate and struggled with his speech.
- Although Moses focused on his tangled words, Stephen later looked back and described him as powerful in speech and action.
- In hindsight, Moses' words carried lasting weight because God used them to offer justice, deliver freedom, and give life.
- Believers often point out their own limitations and deficiencies when God asks them to step outside their comfort zone.
- God does not require our natural eloquence or self-sufficiency, but simply our willingness to trust and obey Him.
